from shop.pricing import compute_total


class Cart:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = []

    def add(self, price, qty=1):
        self.items.append((price, qty))

    def total(self, tax=0.0):
        return compute_total(self.items, tax)

==== shop/pricing.py ====
def compute_total(items, tax=0.0):
    """Total of (price, qty) pairs plus tax."""
    sub = sum(p * q for p, q in items)
    return round(sub * (1 + tax), 2)
